name: Shells
description: A woman in her early thirties, a gentle, wonderstruck shell collector who sings soft Laurel Canyon folk.
build: A slender adult build of ordinary proportions: narrow shoulders, a soft waist, and slim arms and legs, standing upright with straight knees.
face: Light olive skin with a sun-warmed nose, large hazel eyes under soft brown brows, a small nose, round cheeks and full lips.
hair: Long wavy chestnut-brown hair past the shoulders, parted in the middle, with a band of big white and coral shells tied across the crown.
outfit: An open-weave cream crochet cover-up dress to the knees with large bold diamond holes, opaque with a solid sand-coloured slip dress underneath, short flutter sleeves; a long necklace of big turquoise and white shells; a woven straw bag on a strap across the body at the character-left hip; bare feet.
performance_style: Soft and open: feet close together, weight on one hip, knees soft. The character-right hand open at chest height, palm up as if offering a shell to the light; the character-left hand resting open on the strap of the bag, fingers visible. Head tipped a little, eyes wide and lips parted.
location: A quiet tidepool cove at golden hour: glistening sand and rock pools running to the bottom of the frame, dark rocks scattered with starfish, gentle waves behind, and a warm peach sky.
recognition_cues: a cream crochet cover-up with big diamond holes
a band of big shells across the crown
a necklace of big turquoise shells

sing.intent: Folk vocal loop: she brings the mic in the character-right hand up to the mouth, sways gently side to side with the eyes half closed, the character-left hand drifting open at shoulder height, then returns to the soft stance. The mouth must visibly open and change shape across the loop so she unmistakably reads as singing.

animations.flinch: Brief startle at a loud beach sound: the shoulders jump, the torso draws back and both open hands rise to chest height, then she settles back into the opening stance. No opponent, strike or contact.
animations.guard: One-shot stage self-protection: step the feet a little wider, bring the character-left forearm across the chest with the character-right hand open at the hip, and hold a steady grounded finish. Not combat.
animations.entrance: One-shot entrance: she wanders in slowly, looking down at the sand, straightens with a wondering look and settles into the soft stance.
